blurb: Guests embark on 3.5 to 4 hour narrated whale watching trips from Barnstable Harbor, observing humpback, fin, and minke whales, as well as seals and dolphins. An extended 6-hour deep-sea adventure is also offered, including a wildlife photography workshop and marine wildlife insights. Food, beverage, and bar service are available on board, with indoor and outdoor seating.
extraNote: Parking $15 cash next to the harbour · E-tickets available for purchase online · Barnstable Harbor · Summer season, with trips available at least through September
